title: Investigation
subtitle: Manage Investigative Case Data, Documents, and Evidence
descHeading: Complete case management system to support the investigation process
descContent: Manage investigations with an extensive range of information such as reports, evidence, contacts, assignments, arrests, warrants, and more. Document specialized investigation data including arson, burglary, death, narcotics, robbery, sexual assault, and vehicle crashes.
highlights: Efficient case intake and document management tool
Powerful search capabilities and permission settings

sysTitle.title: Spend more time on investigation, less time on paperwork.

sysFeatures.title: Case Intake & Data Management
sysFeatures.desc: Efficient case intake and organization of investigation information such as incident, location, investigation case type, suspect, police officer, organization, event, staff assignment, and disposition. Submodules contain crime-specific fields to assist investigative staff with special investigations.
list: Configurable support files and business rules
Flexible region-, role-, or case-based permission settings
Folder-based file management (discovery, LIMS, non-discovery, post-conviction)

sysFeatures.title: Streamlined Workflow
sysFeatures.desc: A workflow-optimized user interface improves investigative staff productivity. Users can quickly locate caseload information, add case events, create reports, or view assignments and active cases from a single window.
list: Time management and scheduling calendar service

sysFeatures.title: Extensive Search Capabilities
sysFeatures.desc: Given the wealth of cases, documents, multimedia files, and reports, investigative staff need powerful search capabilities to quickly and easily find the necessary information.
list: Extensive global and local search options

sysFeatures.title: Investigative Reporting & Approval
sysFeatures.desc: With CSI’s patented intake form technology, users can create, customize, and re-use reports and send them to supervisors for approval. Robust permission settings ensure only authorized staff members can access and update a case.
list: Prepopulated investigation, arrest, and supplemental reports
Paperless reporting and approval with digital signature

sysFeatures.title: Investigative Analytics Tools
sysFeatures.desc: Analytics tools leverage data for investigative insights, enabling users to run multidimensional crime analysis and advanced queries across disparate datasets. Users can visualize crime trends and the relationships between people, vehicles, organizations, and more.

benefits.title: Special Investigation
benefits.desc: Enhance investigation capabilities with specialized case types

title: Intelligence
subtitle: Manage Intelligence Data in a 28 CFR Part 23 Database
descHeading: Intelligence data management, reporting, and analytics for intelligence-led policing
descContent: A criminal intelligence system developed to easily create, manage, and use permission-based settings to share data for investigation support and crime activity analysis. Other features include crime mapping, link analysis, robust search capabilities, streamlined reporting, and configurable interactive dashboard to provide a quantitative and strategic overview of intelligence data.
highlights: Gather, organize, and analyze intelligence data in a 28 CFR Part 23 compliant application
Exchange and disseminate information across agencies
Powerful search capabilities and permission-based settings
Interactive graph of new intelligence reports in the dashboard
Complete integration with other InfoShare™ applications to receive Push-to-Intelligence feature

sysTitle.title: Intelligence analysis and reporting with efficiency and speed

sysFeatures.title: Criminal Intelligence System
sysFeatures.desc: Efficiently manage intelligence data and generate reports in a 28 CFR Part 23 compliant application. Maintain all documents, notes, images, sources, and permissions in separate tabs. The dissemination sensitivity and security setting of each report ensures only authorized individuals have access.
list: Link chart for overview of collected intelligence
Intelligence-led policing with link analysis and crime mapping
Data sharing with robust security and permission settings
Dissemination logs to maintain audit trails

sysFeatures.title: Intelligence Priorities
sysFeatures.desc: Identify information gaps that will provide tactical and strategic information related to criminal activity, disrupt criminal networks, and protect the homeland.
list: Intelligence dissemination for collaboration and information exchange
Criminal activity trend identification and analysis

sysFeatures.title: Configurable Dashboard
sysFeatures.desc: Display intelligence reports, analytics, and provide interactive graphs of new reports. Administratively, view which members are creating reports and identify approved reports by week. Fully customizable to present data that is important to each agency.
list: Multiple datasets and graphs displayed in one window

sysFeatures.title: Global Search
sysFeatures.desc: Search state, county, local agencies, and participating InfoShare™ systems with Global Search. Confidential information in search results is shared based on permission level, and they can be further searched to return specific results.
list: Document repository full-text and keyword search
Interfaces with federal, state, and county law enforcement partners

sysFeatures.title: ALPR Search
sysFeatures.desc: More and more agencies are seeing the value in leveraging ALPR technology to solve crimes, identify suspects, recover stolen vehicles, and create hot lists to assist in investigations. A clean interface allows users to quickly search the CSI ALPR Warehouse and return results.
list: Hot lists for real-time vehicle identification and tracking

sysFeatures.title: Robust Search Capability
sysFeatures.desc: Ad hoc search fields include cyber, criminal organization, person, person details, vehicle, location, phone, activity type, source, and agency to name a few. Search the Master Name Index against connected databases, and person search by criminal activity type.

title: Suspicious Activity Reporting
subtitle: Reporting Function of the SAR Initiative
descHeading: Standardized process for reporting, verifying, and sharing SAR information in one platform
descContent: Enable Law Enforcement partners from local, state, and federal agencies to collect, verify, and share information under the same data sharing platform. Integration with FBI’s eGuardian system and specialized workflow provides checks and balances to ensure information is reviewed and acted upon accordingly.

sysFeatures.title: Suspicious Activity Reporting
sysFeatures.desc: The National SAR Initiative (NSI) is a collaborative effort led by the U.S. Dept of Justice (DOJ), Bureau of Justice Assistance, in partnership with the U.S. Dept of Homeland Security, the FBI, and state, local, tribal, and territorial law enforcement partners.
list: Suspicious persons of interest, locations, and vehicles investigation
Critical infrastructure and soft targets incident tracking
Identification, tracking, and search of extremist ideologies
Robust ad hoc search and Actionable Report generation

sysFeatures.title: Global Search
sysFeatures.desc: Search state, county, local agencies, and participating InfoShare™ systems with Global Search. Confidential information in search results is shared based on permission level, and they can be further searched to return specific results.
list: Document repository full-text and keyword search
Interfaces with federal, state, and county law enforcement partners

sysFeatures.title: Targeted Populations
sysFeatures.desc: Track a targeted population based on the threat to an individual’s ethnicity, national origin, gender/sexual orientation, race, or religion. The SAR platform can be configured to produce customized Target Population reports based on agency needs.
list: Targeted population linkage to specific types of incidents
Domestic and international extremist group data gathering
Threat type and infrastructure trend identification
Configurable support files and business rules

title: Fusion Center (iLog)
subtitle: Comprehensive Toolkit for Information Sharing and Intelligence
descHeading: Track SIN/SARs, manage cases, link documents, and exchange plus disseminate information
descContent: Uniquely developed applications to efficiently handle any type of incident. Tracking, documenting, and disseminating  are performed under a single application tailored to user workflows. Moreover, Fusion Center iLog comes equipped with advanced analytical tools to identify crime trends and patterns, allowing agencies to produce actionable intelligence and prioritize their investigations.
highlights: Maintain situational awareness of any type of incident
Identify locations and infrastructure involved and assets deployed
Incidents are easily pushed to InfoShare™ Intelligence for further analysis and investigation
Control and document information sharing with the Dissemination feature
Customizable levels of incident severity, security setting, and incident priority

sysTitle.title: All-inclusive fusion center suite for intelligence gathering, sharing, production, and policing

sysFeatures.title: Incident/Event Intake
sysFeatures.desc: A complete toolkit for fusion centers to capture the details of any incident/event and document the resources deployed. Incidents are color coded by severity and can be pushed to Intelligence for further analysis and investigation.
list: Success story feature captures outstanding work
Folder-based document management (source, draft, and final, maps)

sysFeatures.title: Master Project Tracking Log
sysFeatures.desc: A workflow-optimized user interface streamlines reporting, so users can spend more time doing the actual work. All documents, files, images, and dissemination documentation can be stored in one application and robustly searched.
list: Dynamically linked fields for customization by multiple units

sysFeatures.title: Request For Information
sysFeatures.desc: Quickly allow users to create and document Requests for Information in a workflow configured to the needs of each agency. Specific databases can be searched to support investigations, enhance intelligence cycles, and provide situational awareness.
list: Federal, state, local agencies or fusion centers request identification
Crime trend analysis for actionable intelligence
Workload analysis for peak resource allocation
Configurable support files and business rules

sysFeatures.title: Push To Intelligence
sysFeatures.desc: Incidents entered into the fusion center can easily be sent to Intelligence for further investigation, analysis, research, and documentation. In addition, any actionable intelligence can be quickly disseminated to the appropriate agencies.

sysFeatures.title: Security
sysFeatures.desc: High level security measures begin with users needing to be the connected to state-level security networks to access intelligence servers. All users must be vetted and complete online training modules dealing with need to know vs. right to know, privacy, and dissemination.

title: Analytics
subtitle: Meaningful Insight and Actionable Intelligence
descHeading: Visualize data to reveal relationships, trends, and patterns of criminal activity
descContent: Leverage advanced data collection and analytics to transform vast amounts of stored data into meaningful and insightful information, revealing crime trends and hidden patterns. Visualize data to draw connections to and between crimes, people, places, and vehicles. Analytics help agencies make better decisions, allocate resources more efficiently, and provide intelligence-led policing.

sysFeatures.title: Intelligence Dashboard
sysFeatures.desc: Provide a visual snapshot of selected data including intelligence reports, analytics, and interactive graphs, customized to user preferences. Each segment can be expanded and explored in detail. Administratively, view which members are creating report and identify approved reports by week.
list: Customizable display of reports and analytics
Multiple datasets and graphs displayed in one window

sysFeatures.title: Visual Links
sysFeatures.desc: Create exportable visual link charts showing relationships between key objects. Simplify complexity, see context, and uncover hidden links or anomalies to provide insight for better decision-making.

sysFeatures.title: Crime Mapping
sysFeatures.desc: Visualize criminal activity patterns, identify crime hot spots, and deploy proactive policing efforts. Drill down on individual incidents and easily access any linked reports. Configurable search features ensure users find the needed data as quickly as possible.

title: Automated License Plate Reader
subtitle: Real-Time Crime and Historical Investigations
descHeading: ALPR data is a force multiplier and valuable tool to solve crimes and deter criminal activity
descContent: Every day more and more ALPR cameras are coming online, storing thousands of plates in ALPR databases. Efficient ALPR searches allow agencies to pinpoint the exact location of where a vehicle may have been or wasn’t, which can either corroborate or refute an individual’s statement as to their whereabouts. CSI’s ALPR is designed for regional interagency data sharing and currently used in Law Enforcement fusion and real-time crime centers, as well as in state, county, and local agencies.

sysFeatures.title: ALPR Search
sysFeatures.desc: Streamlined search process: simply enter the full or partial license plate number and click search.  Results are returned in row format, alongside a map with each numbered read. Each read can be expanded to reveal additional actionable data.
list: Open API of ALPR vendor databases
Federated data search on regional ALPR system

sysFeatures.title: Search Results
sysFeatures.desc: Results returned on the map can be viewed down to the street level, providing a contextual view of the location. Non-relevant reads can be removed and then mapped and exported for more detailed analysis.
list: Thumbnail and full view photos for visual plate verification

sysFeatures.title: ALPR Warehouse
sysFeatures.desc: CSI can create an agency-specific ALPR Warehouse, which receives and stores ALPR reads from other agencies, allowing all associated agencies to search across databases.
list: Regional ALPR collection and sharing network

sysFeatures.title: ALPR Administrative Dashboard
sysFeatures.desc: The main page of the ALPR Administrative Dashboard provides a visual, color-coded description of the current operational status of all agency ALPRs that are feeding the ALPR Warehouse. Any participating agency’s camera can be analyzed to identify possible bad reads.
list: Visual identification of overall operational status
Email notifications for incidents needing review and attention
Camera health check across various time periods
Service alerts for issues and duration of incidents
Daily report of all cameras with configurable alerts in Excel format

title: Global Search Broker
subtitle: Power-Packed Search Engine with Advanced Features
descHeading: Quickly search all of your connected databases and return specific results to aid your investigation
descContent: Global Search has been developed to search all connected sources, by up to eight objects. Users can opt for a standard keyword search or switch to advanced search or person search. Search results are grouped into multiple categories split by local/remote, source, database, and object to allow for a comprehensive overview of the results. Furthermore, results themselves can be searched so that users can find the desired information as quickly as possible.

sysFeatures.title: Search Features
sysFeatures.desc: Connect to an unlimited number of sources including local, county, state, federal, Homeland Security, and participating agencies. Users can search as many or as few databases, with simple keywords or advanced search options.

sysFeatures.title: Search Results
sysFeatures.desc: Search results are grouped by local/remote, source, database, and object. The number of results for each object is clearly identified, allowing users to focus on the information to move their investigations forward.

sysFeatures.title: Narrow Search Results
sysFeatures.desc: Drill-down filtering allows users to refine search results at a more granular level. Users can use specific keywords to narrow down search results in order to find the desired information.
list: Report preview and author details on hover

sysFeatures.title: Advanced Search
sysFeatures.desc: Access advanced search functions to narrow the search scope with Boolean operators (AND, OR, and NOT), date ranges, and structured person search incorporating unique identifiers.

title: Major Incident Management
subtitle: Inter-Agency Collaboration for Complex Investigations
descHeading: Facilitate major incident investigations involving multiple operations, jurisdictions, and/or leads.
descContent: Due to the nature of major incident operations, the command staff has to quickly bring together a body of law enforcement officers from a variety of agencies to manage investigative leads and tasks. There is no time to hesitate, no time for training, and even less time for miscommunication. This module is designed for quick response in these types of emergencies.

sysFeatures.title: Complex Investigations
sysFeatures.desc: Complete personnel management and tracking tool to facilitate an organized approach to major incident investigations in one uniform application. Establish a clear chain of command and work collaboratively with agencies (within or across jurisdictions) towards common objectives.

sysFeatures.title: Preloaded Operation Types
sysFeatures.desc: Command staff can simply select specific operation types for preloaded leads and workflow. Allow system administrators to change support files to add, edit, or remove preloaded information.

sysFeatures.title: Lead Management
sysFeatures.desc: Enhance multiple lead investigations across agencies and jurisdictions with lead tracking, assignment, prioritization, and linking. Link analysis visually maps the relationships between leads.

sysFeatures.title: Security
sysFeatures.desc: Law enforcement, prosecutor offices, and other agencies can share the same operation whilst keeping sensitive data secure and separated. Flexible workgroup access permissions ensure data privacy.

title: Crime Scene Investigation
subtitle: Rolmes™ Revolutionizes Crime Scene Investigations
descHeading: Integrate crime scene findings with criminal case management
descContent: Named after master detective Sherlock Holmes, Rolmes™ short for Robotic Holmes is an innovative integration of hardware, software, and robotic technology to modernize crime scene investigations. It is accessible on scene and guarantees accurate evidence and data collection, providing a knowledge base for crime scene processing and offering crime scene technicians tools that meet the highest standards for identifying, processing, and collecting evidence. Rolmes™ was conceived in collaboration with world-renowned forensic scientist, Dr. Henry Lee.

sysFeatures.title: Physical Evidence Record Collection
sysFeatures.desc: Manage chain of custody and current repository of crime scene data linked to cases, keeping all data organized and updated for quick access.

sysFeatures.title: Crime Scene Data Recording
sysFeatures.desc: Collect photo and video evidence from built-in cameras or digital cameras, with tagging functions and deleted items recovery. Log information and contacts can be recorded and linked to evidence along with related sub-evidence items.

sysFeatures.title: Information Sharing
sysFeatures.desc: Real-time synchronization of crime scene data with the criminal case management system enables authorized staff to immediately access the data. With offline mode, evidence collected during offline period can be synchronized to the server when the user is back online.

sysFeatures.title: Hardware Integration & Evidence Process
sysFeatures.desc: With hardware integration, users can generate barcode labels of evidence, print them with a barcode printer, and mail the evidence receipts together with digital signatures. Crime Scene Log reports and PPT reports can be generated with a single click.

sysFeatures.title: SOP Checklist & Knowledge Base
sysFeatures.desc: Investigate crime in an effective, efficient manner with embedded SOPs to eliminate problems resulting from inadmissible evidence or failure in gathering evidence. Rolmes™ builds a knowledge base to facilitate crime analysis and intelligence gathering.
